title: Register the pane's dashboard tool for Claude, and route the lore skill's dashboard verb to it
description:
Operator instruction, 2026-10-03, first-party in opum-doc (seq 174, recorded on opum-agent OPAG-1089), relayed by opum-agent: each pane mod registers a dashboard tool Claude can call, so the plugin's own skill opens the pane for 'lore dashboard' and sends everything else to the CLI. Design of record: opum-doc docs/reference/pane-dashboard-tool-design.md (opum-ai/opum-doc#629, main dfde45e) -- read it there, by ref.

lore-cli builds the Lore side: the mod registers mcp__opum-lore__dashboard (inputs doc, query, full), the generated lore skill learns the verb and the fallback, and the design's tests run on terminal and desktop. quest-cli builds the Quest side. Delivered on LCLI-666's branch and PR with seq 171 (focus) and seq 173 (/lore rename), on the orchestrator's instruction that all three go into 0.13.0 together.

acceptanceCriteria.text: The mod registers `mcp__opum-lore__dashboard` at `session.start` and serves it from a `tool.call` hook; the description it is listed with stays to one or two sentences.

Calling the tool opens the pane: no input opens the pane as it stands, `doc` opens that concept on the Read tab, `query` opens the Search tab carrying that text, and `full` asks for the full size. Every open is made without focus, so Claude calling the tool never takes the keyboard from the person.
An unknown `doc` id returns an error result naming the id, and opens nothing else in its place.

The generated `lore` skill routes "lore dashboard" (and "open this doc in the pane") to `mcp__opum-lore__dashboard` and everything else to the `lore` CLI as today, and it states the fallback for where the tool is unavailable -- Claude Code older than 2.1.287, a `claude -p` run, or mods off: say the pane is unavailable and answer from the CLI instead. The skill file is regenerated from its source rather than hand-edited.
The design's tests run on the terminal and the desktop surface: the registration and the focusless open, each input landing where it should, and the unknown-id error.

implementationNotes:
ROUTING REFINED, 2026-10-03 (opum-doc seq 180, relay ODOC-OP-2026-10-03-11, read verbatim on opum-agent OPAG-1089 at origin/dev `647473bd`): ONE `dashboard` verb with modifiers after it, superseding seq 176's separate `dashboard`/`pane`/`full` arguments. The `lore` skill routes `/lore dashboard`, `/lore dashboard full`, `/lore dashboard <doc-id>` and `/lore dashboard search <text>` to `mcp__opum-lore__dashboard` (full, doc, query), in plain words as well; there is NO bare `full`, `pane` or `board` verb; every argument that does not start with `dashboard` goes to the CLI. The design (docs/reference/pane-dashboard-tool-design.md, landing as ODOC-393) also now states that the tool is the pane's ONLY entry point.

GATE ADDITION accepted for this release: the live-session probe must also assert that `session.start` printed no "hook skipped" line. That is what would have caught the 2.1.288 throw measured on the renamed command -- `opum-lore: session.start hook skipped: threw opum-lore: $.command.register: "/lore" refused: it is the plugin's /opum-lore:lore` -- which `claude plugin validate --strict` and the 49 mod tests both pass over.

Any parsing conflict between these argument forms and an existing CLI argument is reported to opum-agent as an issue rather than settled here.
